maria (eng): Hey — CI in account 222 just started failing kms:Decrypt after yesterday's CMK rotation. Artifacts can't be decrypted in the deploy step. Getting AccessDenied. Anyone seen this pattern before?

clare (sec-eng): Can you paste the exact error snippet and how CI assumes creds? is this AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity or cross-account AssumeRole?

maria (eng): It's GitHub Actions OIDC -> AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity into our CI role in account 222. Error: 
```
Error: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::222:assumed-role/ci-role/session is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/abcd-... (403)
Caused by: KMS: Access denied
RequestParameters: {EncryptionContext: {artifact-id: "build-2026-03-19"}}
```
No obvious InvalidCiphertext, it's AccessDenied. Also saw no GrantToken present.

samir (infra): Two quick suspects: 1) Key policy has a condition on PrincipalTag/environment or similar and the assumed session has no tags. 2) Session policy or role session duration trimmed privileges. Rotation can also affect grants. Do you have the key policy?

maria (eng): Pasting relevant key policy clause: 
```
{
  "Sid": "AllowProdPrincipals",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "*"},
  "Action": "kms:Decrypt",
  "Resource": "*",
  "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:PrincipalTag/environment": "prod"}}
}
```
That would explain it if tags aren't present.

clare (sec-eng): Yep. If CI sessions don't pass tags, KMS evaluates that condition as false -> deny. The common pattern is to require session tags to assert environment. With OIDC you can pass tags when assuming the role, but the role's trust policy must allow `sts:TagSession` and the caller must be able to pass them.

kai (sre): Also note: if you were using KMS grants for cross-account decrypt, key rotation can invalidate grants depending on how the grant was created. But the above policy condition looks like the primary cause.

maria (eng): I tried reproducing locally: `aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn arn:aws:iam::222:role/ci-role --role-session-name ci-test --web-identity-token file://token` (no tags) -> decrypt fails. Re-run with `--tags Key=environment,Value=prod` and the decrypt works.

samir (infra): Good repro. Two remediation paths: 1) update CI OIDC mapping/role to pass tags (preferred), ensure trust policy allows `sts:TagSession`. 2) add a narrow key-policy fallback allowing the specific role ARN without tag condition (temporary). 3) change policy to rely on aws:SourceAccount or SourceVpc if that fits.

maria (eng): For GitHub OIDC specifically, we use `assume-role-with-web-identity`. GitHub's OIDC provider can pass claims but we need to set up the mapping to create tags. Do we need any IAM permission changes?

clare (sec-eng): The role's trust policy should include "Condition": { "ForAnyValue:StringLike": {"aws:RequestTag/environment": "prod"} } and also the role needs `sts:TagSession` allowed in the trust relationship context. See AWS docs: allow `sts:TagSession` on the role trust so the caller can add session tags.

maria (eng): One wrinkle: the logs also occasionally show `EncryptionContext` in the request. Could an encryption-context mismatch cause AccessDenied instead of InvalidCiphertext?

kai (sre): Usually encryptioncontext mismatch triggers `InvalidCiphertextException` (or DecryptionFailure). AccessDenied indicates KMS policy/permission evaluation failed. So tags/policy cond is consistent.

samir (infra): Action items: maria will push a test change to GitHub Actions to pass `environment=prod` as a session tag; samir will open a short-lived key-policy PR to allow the CI role ARN for decryption as a fallback; clare will update runbook and note rotation impacts on grants. We'll revert the fallback after CI proves tag flow works.

maria (eng): Working on the GH workflow change now. Will post test output.

deploy-bot: I pushed `key-policy-temp-exception` to prod: https://deploys.internal/2250001299 :rollout: (short-lived)

security-bot: CloudTrail: https://console.aws.amazon.com/cloudtrail/home?region=us-west-2#events?lookupAttributes=EventName:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity shows several sessions without RequestTags. Timestamped events attached to the thread.

maria (eng): Tests: with `--tags` decrypt OK, without tags fails consistently. I'll open PR to update workflow and include a note in the CI docs about `sts:TagSession`.

clare (sec-eng): After PR merges, schedule a small rotation sanity check — confirm decrypt still works and no lingering grant issues. Also add a step to the key-rotation runbook: verify cross-account OIDC sessions include expected tags or have a documented fallback.

samir (infra): +1. I'll coordinate removal of the temporary key-policy exception once we verify.

maria (eng): Thanks all. Will update when CI green. :thumbsup:
